summary: Iteration 98: Employee Management System testing complete. All 33 backend pytest tests passed. Backend endpoints verified: GET /modules (10 modules), GET /role-templates (6 templates), GET /search, POST /link, GET /list?tab=active|pending|unlinked, PUT /{id}, POST /{id}/unlink, POST /{id}/relink, GET /my-access, GET /logs. Frontend correctly redirects to login when not authenticated. Socket.IO mounted at /api/socket.io for real-time access sync.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 98 tested the new Employee Management System for B2B ERP. All backend endpoints require Firebase auth - test with valid token to test full CRUD flows.
